complexity.notes: The dict is keyed by three fixed characters from a constant bracket alphabet, so lookups are O(1) even adversarially; 'bracket in "({["' is a clean constant-time membership check on a 3-char string.
complexity.summary: Classic stack solution: push opening brackets, and on a closing bracket pop and verify it matches via a fixed close-to-open map; the string is valid iff the stack empties with no mismatches.
